initial.name: Interactive exhibition
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a high-fidelity website design concept board for Ziliang Zhang's personal AI applications and engineering showcase, NOT a bank product or SaaS dashboard. Three flat, sharp, front-facing website views on one large landscape board: dominant English desktop homepage (1440:900 viewport aspect) upper-left, Chinese mobile homepage (390:844 viewport aspect, without physical phone bezel) at right, and enlarged English in-context AI explanation expanded state below the desktop view. Clearly separate the three views with small outside labels Desktop / Mobile / Explanation. Large high-resolution canvas, legible editorial UI typography. This is a visual concept, not a functional tool. Preserve generous space and hierarchy. Desktop header: "Ziliang Zhang", "Tools", "Engineering", "Notes", "Contact", "EN / 中文". Main identity: "Making data explorable and AI useful." Small text: "AI applications, data, and backend engineering." Contact text link. Main experiential feature: "Loan comparison" with visible "Interactive preview" label, two illustrative monthly-payment lines (one level, one descending), axes "Monthly payment" and "Years", text labels "Equal payment" and "Equal principal". Use only schematic graph, no currency values or fabricated performance metrics. Include readable "Illustrative" note. One real-looking term slider labeled "Term", "25 years", with minus and plus controls. Small "More inputs", summary labels "First month", "Last month", "Total interest" with em-dash placeholders, and buttons "Explain the difference" and "View data". Below the hero show the beginning of a tools section with Loan comparison / Preview, AI screener / Planned, Japan tax / Planned. No fake live status, no active Try buttons on planned tools. Explanation state is visibly attached BELOW the graph, not a popup or floating chat bubble; label "Example explanation · AI not connected", a short answer "Compare the repayment patterns using the same assumptions.", chips "First month" and "Total interest", input "Ask about this example", Send and Close controls. Mobile has identity reduced to compact Chinese text "张子良", "让数据变得可探索，让 AI 变得有用。", "贷款比较", "交互预览", "年限", "解释差异", "查看数据"; graph and slider visibly fit in the first mobile screen. Avoid mascots, robot heads, stock photographs, neural-network brain art, logo walls, holograms, random charts, floating unrelated panels, huge empty hero illustrations, purple-blue glassmorphism, invented employer logos, fake results. Keep exact words where supplied.
DIRECTION A — INTERACTIVE EXHIBITION. Distinct art-directed editorial gallery website. Warm ivory #F5F2EA canvas, near-black ink #17201D, single deep vermilion #C5472C accent with secondary muted olive chart line. Oversized elegant serif headline paired with precise sans-serif UI; Chinese mobile uses readable restrained serif heading and sans-serif controls. Desktop uses strong asymmetric TWO-COLUMN composition: personal identity in narrow left 35%, enormous crisp chart occupying right 65%, directly integrated into page on plain paper, NOT enclosed in dashboard cards. Hairline horizontal rules, restrained numbered section captions, almost square controls, calm high contrast, no shadows. Big typographic 01 quietly introduces the experience, no giant ornament. Slider feels like a fine gallery instrument aligned under plot. Explanation unfolds as a warm paper editorial footnote with a vermilion rule and data-reference chips. Tools section uses three open typographic columns separated by hairlines. Make it feel memorable through typography and scale, not decoration.

Humanist sans-serif main heading, monospaced numbers and instrument captions only. DIRECTION C — LIVING CANVAS. A playful yet professional personal designer-engineer's interactive canvas. Pale sky-white #EEF3F6 background, saturated cobalt #264FE6 ink, charcoal readable body text, tiny warm orange #E48B4A reference markers. Bold rounded geometric sans-serif headline, clean Chinese sans-serif mobile. Desktop composition is FULL-WIDTH CENTRAL PLOT, not sidebar dashboard: compact identity top-left, headline runs horizontally above a very wide diagram; diagram curves span a large open central canvas. A slim slider strip docks along BOTTOM of the plot; two small anchored text callouts sit near meaningful curve points, connected by neat leader lines. Use large open whitespace and a few purposeful cobalt vector-like contour strokes integrated with the actual data visualization; no arbitrary blobs, no orbiting cards, no 3D extrusions. Explanation state becomes an in-flow light cobalt-tinted annotation strip below graph, with orange numbered references corresponding to plotted markers; no modal. Tools begin as a vertically stacked numbered editorial index ('01 Loan comparison', '02 AI screener', '03 Japan tax') instead of three-card grid. Mobile makes plot compact and uses one annotation below it, with slider visible above the fold. Visually energetic through chart-to-annotation relationships and spatial composition, not animation noise.
